title: Egg Drop Soup
description: Silky ribbons of egg in a gingery, lightly thickened chicken broth with scallions and a drop of sesame oil. Ready in 15 minutes.

image.alt: A bowl of golden egg drop soup with ribbons of egg and green onion

steps.text: Bring the broth, ginger, soy sauce and white pepper to a simmer in the saucepan.
Stir the cornstarch with {qty 3 tbsp} cold water until smooth, then stir it into the simmering broth. Cook, stirring, until slightly thickened and glossy, {time 1-2 min}.
Beat the eggs well. Stir the soup in one direction to make a slow whirlpool, then pour in the eggs in a thin stream. Let them set for a few seconds before stirring gently to form ribbons.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the sesame oil and taste for salt. Serve topped with green onions.

notes: A thin, steady stream of egg into moving broth is what makes fine ribbons.
Add a handful of frozen peas or corn with the broth for a more filling soup.
